items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: for years, he had been with Ted Lewis

ctx.x: Well, tell us about getting the horn and the playing in the Sunday school band--

Well, of course, first I went to-- the band got a job at a lake in the Summertime and I went up to a lake called Hamilton Lake, Indiana and I played that whole summer up there and we were -- the band was just very popular; everybody loved the band and, mind you now, we were just kids and we were pounding out some pretty darn good dance music for that time. And, of course, we used to all wait in line when the records would come in the shop so we could hear Ted Lewis, Isham Jones and that's the only jazz we heard.…
